label: Dionysius of Corinth wrote a letter to the church at Nicomedia

date.note: Dionysius, bishop of Corinth, wrote his catholic epistles during the Roman episcopate of Soter (c. 166-174), to whom he also wrote. The range brackets that episcopate; his floruit is c. 170.

primary.cite: Dionysius of Corinth, Letter to the Nicomedians, in Eusebius, Hist. eccl. 4.23.4

secondary.cite: Harnack, Mission and Expansion, vol. 2, p. 188; synopsis at p. 95

notes: Eusebius (HE 4.23.4) reports that Dionysius' letter to Nicomedia attacked the heresy of Marcion and upheld the rule of truth. A contemporary attestation of the church there c. 170. Nicomedia (511337, mod. Izmit) is the metropolis of Bithynia; this is the first named city for the province whose Christians Pliny and 1 Peter attest only at the provincial level (lit-pliny-bithynia, lit-1peter-bithynia).
